capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Jeep gives gross only; the Charger Daytona sheet states 93.9 kWh usable of 100.5 for the same 400 V, 100.5 kWh pack (ratio 0.934).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Spec sheet: 400-volt pack and 250 kW / 400 V motors. (Jeep FAQ reportedly mentions an available 800-volt system; page 403, contradicted by this spec sheet.)

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Jeep has not published a Recon peak (Electrek) and outlets quote 160-220 kW. Used the Wagoneer S rating (203 kW, InsideEVs) as a sibling with the same 100.5 kWh pack; Jeep quotes 5-80 % in about 28 min for the Recon and 20-80 % in 23 min for the Wagoneer S. Conflict: the Charger Daytona on the same pack is 183 kW (Stellantis sheet). Owner call: 183 or 203.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Jeep gives no kW for the IDCM/OBCM; Charger Daytona (same pack) is 11 kW and the Recon's 6.8 h for 5-80 % on 240 V (spec sheet) is consistent with about 11 kW. Same charging hardware as the Charger is not proven.
